name: Hidden Files
source:
MC (a former firefighter who became paraplegic after an on-duty accident) struggles with feelings of guilt and uselessness. His wife, Selena, stays by his side and reveals she got a new job in another city, but will ensure he’s cared for by hiring her friend Clara. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/LyaNTR]Patreon[/url]]
